name: Kuroya Mami
source:
A junior who is one year younger than [url=https://vndb.org/c65827]Aki[/url] When she first moved from the city to the countryside, Aki reached out to her, and they became friends from there. 

Since then, she's admired Akatsuki and became the track team manager, supporting her wholeheartedly. She's friendly and easygoing. Great at teasing. 

An honor student academically and generally serious, but when it comes to Aki, she sometimes gets starry-eyed and lets her feelings show...

Honestly, she thinks the village is a boring place.

[From [url=https://hamham-soft.net/imokega/chr3.html]Official website[/url]]
